steps.name: make caramel
steps.note: Sugar and water are cooked to a deep brown and poured into the moulds to harden.
Milk with vanilla is brought to a simmer.

steps.what: eggs and yolks whisked with sugar
steps.note: The hot milk is whisked into the eggs and the custard poured over the caramel.
Baked in a water bath two thirds up the moulds until just set, with the centre at 80 °C.
Chilled for at least 3 hours or overnight.

steps.name: turn out
steps.note: A knife is run round the edge and the dessert inverted so the caramel runs down.

sources.text: The caramel in the mould, the egg and milk custard, the baking in a water bath and the turning out, from these.
